capabilities: Correct the previous misspelled word when space is pressed
Skip words saved in Obsidian's custom dictionary
Use suggestions from the operating system's native spellchecker
disambiguation: Not a spellchecker or red-underline tool; it only replaces the previous word when space is pressed.
extras: Desktop-only (Windows and macOS suggest different corrections). README instructs manual installation by copying manifest.json and main.js into the community plugins folder; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian only flags misspellings; it has no built-in way to autocorrect a mistyped word as you type.
summary: Desktop-only autocorrect that fixes the last word with your OS spellchecker's first suggestion when you press space, with backspace to undo.
